evals.name: pr-authoring-title-format
evals.prompt: Create a draft pull request for issue #102 adding support for JWT authentication. Format the title and body properly.
evals.expected_output: A draft PR created with title '[#102] Add JWT authentication support' and structured body using templates/pull_request.md, requesting user confirmation before submission.

evals.name: pr-conflict-resolution-author
evals.prompt: Resolve merge conflicts on PR branch feature/auth against origin/main as the author.
evals.expected_output: Guidance on using an isolated worktree in /tmp/, merging origin/main, resolving conflicts, and standard pushing without force-push.

evals.name: pr-stack-general-rules-and-rebase-policy
evals.prompt: How do we handle conflicts and mid-stack review changes in a stacked pull request chain compared to a standalone PR?
evals.expected_output: Explains that stacked PRs rely on cascading rebases rather than merge commits to preserve linear layer diffs, requires checking out the owning lower layer for mid-stack fixes followed by an upstack rebase, ensures every layer compiles and passes tests independently, and uses references/stacked-prs.md for gh stack execution commands.

evals.name: issue-creation-triage
evals.prompt: Create a bug report issue for a memory leak in the Zsh completions module when parsing large command histories. Ensure fallback templates and explicit user approval guidelines are followed.
evals.expected_output: A structured bug report using templates/bug_report.md with clear reproduction steps and an explicit request for user approval before posting.

evals.name: issue-comment-update
evals.prompt: Post an update comment on issue #42 regarding reproduction steps and a link to draft PR #45.
evals.expected_output: A concise, neutral comment linking #45 with clear technical reproduction steps and no conversational filler.
